# How-to-Germany.com

> A comprehensive expat guide to navigating banking, financial products, and insurance in Germany with practical comparisons and setup instructions.

How-to-Germany.com is a resource for expatriates moving to or living in Germany, covering essential financial services including bank accounts, credit cards, brokers, and insurance options. The site provides detailed comparisons of German and international financial providers, helping expats make informed decisions about their financial setup.

## Key Topics

- German Banking
- Expat Finance
- Bank Accounts
- Credit Cards
- Health Insurance
- N26
- Trade Republic
- German IBAN
- GKV vs PKV
- Blocked Accounts
- Business Banking
- Savings Accounts
- Insurance Comparison
- Financial Products
- Visa & Mastercard

## Bank Accounts & Opening

- [Comprehensive Guide to Banking in Germany for Expats 2026](https://www.how-to-germany.com/./banking): Comprehensive banking guide for expats covering accounts, finances, and banking setup
- [How to Open a Bank Account in Germany – Guide for Expats](https://www.how-to-germany.com/bank-accounts/open-bank-account): Step-by-step guide to opening bank accounts in Germany with N26 and Revolut options
- [Best Bank Accounts in Germany in 2026 – Guide for Expats](https://www.how-to-germany.com/bank-accounts): Comparison of best German bank accounts for expats including DKB and ING options
- [Blocked Account for Students in Germany – Process & Requirements](https://www.how-to-germany.com/bank-accounts/blocked-account): Guide to blocked accounts required for student and work visas in Germany
- [Best Savings Accounts in Germany in 2026 – Expat Guide](https://www.how-to-germany.com/bank-accounts/savings): Guide to savings accounts in Germany comparing TF Bank and Consorsbank interest rates

## Credit Cards & Payment Methods

- [Best Credit Cards in Germany in 2026 – Guide for Expats](https://www.how-to-germany.com/credit-cards): Comparison of credit cards in Germany including Visa, Mastercard, and Amex options
- [N26 Credit Cards in Germany — Fees, Benefits & Application](https://www.how-to-germany.com/credit-cards/reviews/n26): Detailed review of N26 Mastercard offerings, fees, and benefits for expats
- [American Express Credit Cards in Germany — Benefits, Costs & Top Options](https://www.how-to-germany.com/credit-cards/reviews/american-express): Review of American Express and Amex Blue cards available in Germany for expats
- [Best Debit Cards in Germany in 2026 – Guide for Expats](https://www.how-to-germany.com/credit-cards/types/debit): Guide to debit cards in Germany comparing DKB Visa and Commerzbank Mastercard
- [Best Prepaid Credit Cards in Germany in 2026 – Expat Guide](https://www.how-to-germany.com/credit-cards/types/prepaid): Overview of prepaid credit cards in Germany for expats without credit history

## Health Insurance

- [German Health Insurance – Public vs. Private Systems](https://www.how-to-germany.com/health-insurance): Comprehensive guide to German health insurance comparing GKV and PKV systems
- [Statutory Health Insurance Germany: Best Expat Plans 2026](https://www.how-to-germany.com/health-insurance/statutory-health-insurance): Guide to statutory health insurance (GKV) in Germany for expats in 2026
- [Best Private Health Insurance for Expats in Germany 2026](https://www.how-to-germany.com/health-insurance/private-health-insurance): Guide to private health insurance in Germany with ottonova and Feather providers
- [Best Private Health Insurance for Students in Germany in 2026](https://www.how-to-germany.com/health-insurance/private-health-insurance/students): Guide to private health insurance for international students in Germany via ottonova
- [Best Dental Insurance Germany | Policies and Providers 2026](https://www.how-to-germany.com/health-insurance/dental-insurance): Comparison of dental insurance providers in Germany including Ottonova and Feather

## Business & Investment Banking
